notes.title: Now the game can only be played in VR
notes.notes: Because the PC version is not optimized, leading to bad user experiences, we decided to remove the PC version to update

notes.title: Tactical Rampart is going to support PC edition
notes.notes:
Tactical Rampart, the gripping RPG game that has enthralled gamers in VR mode, is now gearing up for an even more expansive experience with its upcoming PC edition. As the anticipation builds, let's delve into what makes this teaser an essential addition to the gaming world.

[h1]The Immersive World of Tactical Rampart[/h1]
For those unfamiliar with Tactical Rampart, the game sets players on a thrilling journey, battling hordes of zombies in a virtual reality environment. The immersive gameplay and strategic elements have captivated audiences, making it a standout title in the VR gaming realm.

[h1]Transition to PC: What to Expect[/h1]
The introduction of the PC edition opens up new dimensions for Tactical Rampart enthusiasts. The teaser promises to bring the same intense RPG experience to a wider audience, allowing players to explore the captivating universe of Tactical Rampart on their desktops.

[h1]Join the Teaser Experience[/h1]
As the teaser for the PC edition of Tactical Rampart unfolds, gamers around the world are invited to join the excitement. Whether you're a seasoned VR player or a PC gaming enthusiast, Tactical Rampart promises an unforgettable journey through space, teeming with challenges, and the undead.

Add Tactical Rampart to your wishlist to stay tuned for updates as ventures beyond virtual reality, bringing its gripping RPG gameplay to a broader audience. The teaser is just the beginning of an epic gaming adventure that awaits on the PC platform.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522300/Tactical_Rampart/

We are looking forward to hearing your feedback in the Community. Let's discuss!
